name: Militant Spellcaster (Combat)
body:
Your enemies underestimate your strength until you enhance your strikes with magic.

Prerequisite(s): Power Attack, Spellcasting Class Feature

Benefit: When making a Melee Power Attack as a swift action, you can sacrifice one spell per caster level to enhance the physical damage of one attack by 1d4 per level of the spell sacrificed. Special: The damage enhancement is not expended until you make a successful Power Attack, make a normal attack, or combat ends.
